title: Stakeholder selection

questions.text: Are we involving the right people for this action?

inputs: buying group with roles and status

criteria.text: the active champion is not bypassed
criteria.guide: Unless ownership was delegated or the champion left, the active champion stays on the path.

criteria.text: material goes to the stakeholder whose function it serves
criteria.guide: Security material reaches the active security stakeholder, not only the commercial contact.

criteria.text: no executive is involved without a request for escalation
criteria.guide: An executive is involved only when the working team asked for escalation.

criteria.text: an explicitly required stakeholder is not omitted
criteria.guide: Anyone the customer named as required for this step is included.

criteria.text: every addressee is a verified member of the buying group
criteria.guide: Commercial or confidential material is not sent to an addressee the evidence does not tie to the account's process.

failure_examples: sending security material only to commercial contact when a security stakeholder is active
involving an executive when the working team has not asked for escalation
principles: Breadth (how many people) is stakeholder_coverage; this eval judges whether they are the RIGHT people.

diagnostics.name: wrong_stakeholder
diagnostics.when: a recipient is the wrong person for the step, or a required one is missing

diagnostics.name: champion_bypassed
diagnostics.when: the active champion is dropped without delegation or departure
